name: Nick La'juck
source: Nick has been a member of the Oasis Clan since before the beginning of the game, and is also an accomplished adventurer since before that. Took upon himself the task of training the inexperienced Carina and Leicester. Strong warrior, is a huge fan of axes. Not as scary (or old) as his face makes one believe.
